description: Defines the internal class 'NatsStreamMessage', a serializable message structure for NATS streaming use within Orleans, along with a JSON serialization context.

classes.name: NatsStreamMessage
classes.description: Represents a stream message with properties for stream identification, request context, payload, and reply-to address.

classes.name: NatsSerializerContext
classes.description: A JSON serializer context class for NatsStreamMessage, with serialization options specified.
